full_prompt_en: A square painterly portrait shows a stern seated adventurer in a weathered room, with a dark bird perched just behind one shoulder. The background is a scraped beige and ochre wall, layered with stains, sketchy circular marks, and indistinct shelves or objects along the left. The figure sits centrally, facing the viewer. A dark wide three-cornered hat with a feather-like tuft shades the forehead; gray-white curls emerge beside the ears. The face is modeled with warm brown shadow, a straight gaze, and a closed mouth. One hand rises near the cheek holding a slender smoking pipe, while the other rests near the lap and a small metal cup. A loose white shirt opens at the neck, its cuffs puffed and rumpled under a reddish-brown coat. Broad dark straps and a large metal buckle cross the torso and waist, adding hard accents among the soft fabric folds. Brown trousers occupy the lower half, cropped close by the frame. On the right behind the shoulder, a black vulture-like bird faces left, its dark plumage separated from the wall by rough highlights. The room's objects are deliberately unresolved: dark shelves and circular marks form a distressed setting rather than a precise inventory. Warm directional light from the upper left catches the face, white collar, hands, buckle, and parts of the coat, while the hat brim and lower clothing remain in shadow. The medium uses thick broken strokes, scumbled paint, scratches, and partly lost edges around more carefully rendered eyes and hands. No readable text appears. The overall composition is compact and theatrical, balancing the upright central figure with rough wall texture and a dark organic shape at the shoulder.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形绘画式肖像呈现一名神情严肃的冒险者，坐在风化室内，一只深色鸟停在一侧肩后。背景是刮擦过的米赭色墙，叠着污渍、随手画出的圆形痕迹，左边还有模糊架子或物品。人物居中而坐，面向观者。深色宽大的三角帽带羽毛状饰物，在额头投影；灰白卷发从耳侧露出。面部以暖棕影塑形，目光笔直，嘴巴闭合。一只手在脸颊附近举着细烟斗，另一只手靠近腿部和小金属杯。宽松白衬衫在颈部敞开，蓬松皱褶的袖口从红棕外套下露出。宽深色带子与大金属扣横过胸身和腰间，在柔软衣褶中形成坚硬重音。棕裤占据下半部，被画边紧密裁去。右侧肩后，一只黑色秃鹫般的鸟朝左，暗羽借粗糙亮笔从墙上分离。室内物件有意不完全解析：暗架子与圆痕构成磨损背景，而非精确物品清单。来自左上的暖色定向光照亮脸、白领、手、金属扣和部分外套，帽檐与下方衣服留在阴影中。媒介采用厚重断笔、擦涂颜料、划痕和局部消失的边缘，眼睛与手则画得更仔细。没有可读文字。整体构图紧凑且有舞台感，以直立中央人物平衡粗糙墙面肌理和肩旁深色有机形。
style_prompt_en: Painterly illustration mixes selective realist modeling with aggressive scumbling, scraped marks, and rough layered brushwork. Warm sepia, umber, bone white, and restrained rusty red build a weathered tonal world, with small metallic highlights providing harder accents. Focal details are rendered clearly inside broad surrounding passages where contour, surface, and background partly merge. Light arrives directionally, bringing pale planes forward while leaving deep recesses and lower areas dark. Thick broken strokes run across both figure and setting, so the atmosphere feels worked over rather than cleanly finished. The composition is close and frontal, organized around an upright central mass and a few asymmetrical dark accents. Fine scratches and circular ghost marks enrich open areas without competing with the face-level focal zone. The overall effect is rugged, dramatic, and tactile, with visible revisions of the paint surface adding character to the image.
style_prompt_zh: 绘画式插画把选择性写实塑形与强烈擦涂、刮擦痕迹及粗糙叠层笔触结合起来。暖褐、棕黑、骨白和克制的锈红建立风化明度世界，少量金属似的亮部提供较硬重音。焦点细节在宽阔周边色区中画得清楚，其他地方轮廓、表面和背景局部融合。定向光把浅色面推向前，深凹处和下部保持昏暗。厚重断笔横过主体与环境，使气氛像反复加工过而非干净完稿。构图亲近而正面，以直立中央体块和少数不对称深色重音组织。细划痕与圆形幽灵痕迹丰富空处，却不争夺面部高度的焦点区域。整体效果粗犷、戏剧化且有触感，可见的颜料修订为图像增添性格。
theme_en: A stern seated adventurer with a dark bird in a weathered room
theme_zh: 风化室内，一名严肃的冒险者坐在深色鸟旁
name: Jean-Sebastien Rossbach
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
